issue_needs_context_not_application_targ.text: Whether the alleged occupation and operation of the supplied premises by M/s Goel Handloom House and M/s Goel Foam and Furnishing can be characterized as subletting, assignment, or other parting with possession, given the competing claim that there were two separate tenancies rather than one tenancy later divided.

Whether the relevant arrangement lacked the landlord's written consent, considering the petitioners' allegation of no written permission and the respondent's allegation of a landlord-approved written understanding dated 10.03.2008.

Whether the respondent retained participation, possession, or control through the two family partnership firms, and how the identity of the tenant or tenants relates to the alleged transfer of possession.

What temporal and procedural conditions in the supplied Delhi provisions are potentially implicated by an arrangement alleged to have existed or changed in 2008 and by the eviction petition filed in 2012.

Whether any supplied corporate-amalgamation, banking-transfer, acquisition, or non-Delhi rent-law material has a factual connection to this record, which describes family partnership firms and alleged tenancy arrangements rather than a corporate or statutory amalgamation.
